description:
Retire the private git setup in library unit-test modules in favour of the shared helper.

## Background

Shared test support provides a git initialisation function with a fixed author identity and no dependency on global git configuration. Eight library test modules hand-roll `git init`: `crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs`, `storage/json.rs`, `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`, `commands/mod.rs`, `commands/hooks.rs`, `commands/worktree.rs`, `profile/repository_package.rs` and `commands/archive.rs`.

This entry covers `gate_execution.rs`, `json.rs`, `repository_state_store_tests.rs`, `repository_package.rs`.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`: `capture_git_fixture` (`:2587`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No library test module defines a git initialisation helper or spawns `git init` itself; each uses the shared function.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Storage and gate-execution tests initialise git through the shared helper
